第60章 恶鬼逃脱1-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

下一章

云川急了，恶鬼是因为他的原因才逃脱的，要是早听吴姜的话，说不定恶鬼已经在十八层地狱畅游了。

“师叔祖，我也跟你们一起去！”

吴姜也连忙附和：“是啊，前辈，我们一起去吧，说不定能够帮上忙呢？”

开玩笑，龙虎山敢只来三个人，说明拿下那恶鬼根本不在话下，这么大的热闹，他怎么可能错过？

灵虚道长看向云川：“你的伤没有问题？”

云川连忙摇头，示意自己没有问题。

灵虚道长点了点头，不再阻拦。

于是，几人不再磨叽，翻身下了高速路上的隔离带，向着恶鬼逃跑的山林冲去。

进了山林，几人停下脚步。

云川的师傅玄丰道长从口袋里掏出一张黄纸，手指翻飞，快速将黄纸折叠成一只纸鹤，口中念念有词，指尖弹出一道灵气，注入纸鹤体内。

下一秒，纸鹤瞬间活了过来，扑扇着翅膀，朝着恶鬼逃离的方向飞去。

吴姜看的眼热不已，这招比起罗盘寻鬼，还要看着潇洒，记得兑换中心里，就有纸鹤引路的术法，下定决心，回去就要学到手。

几人的脚程都极快，云川虽然受了伤，但还是强撑着跟在后面。

一行人沿着纸鹤指引的方向，在漆黑的山林里快速穿梭，吴姜一边走，一边留意周围的动静，同时也在感受着空气中的阴邪气息。

只是，天空泛起了鱼肚白，还是没有追上恶鬼的踪影。

又往前追了半个小时，这下，就连那只引路的纸鹤，都开始在空中打转，寻不到恶鬼的气息了。

最终，直直坠落在地，化作一张普通的黄纸，随风飘落在草丛里。

灵宸道长叹息了一声：“回去吧，那恶鬼已经不知道藏到哪里了，天亮更不容易找到了！”

事已至此，众人也只能无功而返。

等他们回到停车的地方时，天早已大亮，高速路上的车辆渐渐多了起来。

Chapter 60 The Evil Ghost Escapes 1 - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of God"

Yun Chuan was anxious. The evil ghost escaped because of him. If he had listened to Wu Jiang earlier, the evil ghost might have been swimming in the eighteenth level of hell.

"Uncle Master, I will go with you too!"

Wu Jiang also quickly agreed: "Yes, senior, let's go together, maybe we can help?"

Just kidding, only three people dared to come to Longhu Mountain, which meant that taking down the evil ghost was not a problem at all. How could he miss such a big event?

Taoist priest Lingxu looked at Yunchuan: "Is there any problem with your injury?"

Yun Chuan shook his head quickly, indicating that he had no problem.

Taoist priest Lingxu nodded and stopped blocking him.

So, the few people stopped grinding, got off the isolation belt on the highway, and rushed towards the forest where the evil ghost escaped.

After entering the forest, several people stopped.

Yunchuan's master, Taoist Master Xuanfeng, took out a piece of yellow paper from his pocket, flicked his fingers, and quickly folded the yellow paper into a paper crane. He muttered something in his mouth, and a stream of spiritual energy popped up from his fingertips and was injected into the paper crane.

The next second, the paper crane came to life, flapped its wings, and flew in the direction where the evil ghost fled.

Wu Jiang's eyes were filled with excitement. This trick was more elegant than looking for ghosts with a compass. He remembered that in the redemption center, there was a trick of paper cranes to guide the way. He was determined to learn it when he went back.

The steps of several people were extremely fast. Although Yun Chuan was injured, he still managed to follow behind.

The group of people quickly shuttled through the dark mountain forest in the direction pointed by the paper crane. As Wu Jiang walked, he paid attention to the movements around him and at the same time felt the sinister atmosphere in the air.

However, the sky turned fish-belly white, but there was still no trace of the evil ghost.

After chasing for another half an hour, even the paper crane that led the way began to spin in the air, and the ghost's breath could no longer be found.

Finally, it fell straight to the ground and turned into an ordinary piece of yellow paper, floating in the grass in the wind.

Taoist Master Lingchen sighed: "Go back, the evil ghost is hiding somewhere, and it will be even harder to find it at dawn!"

At this point, everyone can only return without success.

By the time they returned to the parking place, it was already bright and there were more and more vehicles on the highway.
